existing_application_sources.name: Big Balls Sports Data
existing_application_sources.role: Optional independently sourced EPL fixture identity corroboration; not a prediction, player-prop, lineup or odds feed for public reproduction
existing_application_sources.secret: BBS_API_KEY (GitHub Actions only; rotate key shared in chat)
existing_application_sources.data_license: Provider Terms permit internal storage/model use; prohibit public raw field feeds/exports
existing_application_sources.restrictions: Only exact team + kickoff matches; missing provider records mean unknown, not absent; never infer pick confidence from API meta.confidence.
